response.goal: Build an n8n workflow that triggers on new responses from two Typeform forms, checks the Google Sheet for an existing row with the same email to skip duplicates, adds a new row with name, email, company, form name, and timestamp, posts a message to the #sales Slack channel with a link to the row, and emails if any step fails.

plan.step: Kickoff and requirements review for the self-hosted n8n environment, Typeform, Google Sheets, and Slack setup.
Build the Typeform trigger and data mapping nodes for both forms in n8n.
Implement the duplicate check logic by querying the Google Sheet for existing email addresses.
Add the row creation, Slack channel alert integration, and error handling notification workflow.
Test the end-to-end workflow with sample submissions and deliver to the client.

milestones.name: Milestone 1
milestones.deliverable: Core n8n workflow connecting Typeform triggers to Google Sheets duplicate check and row insertion.

milestones.name: Milestone 2
milestones.deliverable: Slack notifications, error handling email alerts, and final end-to-end testing.

risks.risk: Budget is specified as an hourly rate ($25-$40 per hour) without a total project cap.
risks.mitigation: Establish a weekly hour cap and regular updates so the client has full control over total spend.

risks.risk: Self-hosted n8n environment configuration or permissions issues.
risks.mitigation: Verify API access and webhook permissions for Typeform, Google Sheets, and Slack during kickoff.

questions: Do you already have API credentials and webhooks set up for your self-hosted n8n instance?
What email address or service should receive the failure notification alerts?
assumptions: The client has administrative access to configure webhooks in Typeform and credentials for Google Sheets and Slack.
The client's self-hosted n8n instance is up to date and accessible for development.
